definitions.explanation: A photograph one takes of oneself, typically with a smartphone held at arm's length or using a selfie stick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{自撮|じど}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a selfie at the tourist spot.

examples.japanese: {自撮|じど}り⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a photo using a selfie stick.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{自撮|じど}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I took many selfies to post on social media and picked the best one.

notes:
Short for {自分撮|じぶんど}り (photographing oneself). A modern word that emerged with the spread of smartphones.

USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb: {自撮|じど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The English loanword ⟦セルフィー→セルフィー：30440_serufii⟧ is understood but {自撮|じど}り is the standard Japanese term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自撮|じど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a selfie
- {自撮|じど}り⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧: selfie stick
- {自撮|じど}り⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: selfie photo
- {自撮|じど}り⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: front-facing camera

CULTURAL NOTE:
Taking selfies and posting them on SNS (social media) is very common in Japan. Some tourist spots and restaurants are known as popular {自撮|じど}り⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧ (selfie spots). Note that {自撮|じど}り⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ are prohibited at many Japanese museums and train stations.
